title: Football-field-sized vehicles moving through the ocean at 500 knots

tellings.quote: There are vehicles the size of a football field that are moving through the ocean at 500 knots.
When Lou mentioned the giant underwater thing moving at, you know, 500 knots underwater, that's something this guy talked about.
tellings.difference: Credits Lue Elizondo, not Marco Rubio, and links the claim to the 4chan whistleblower; no football-field size is given.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell the claim that huge objects move underwater at 500 knots.

as_told.title: Lue Elizondo on a giant underwater object moving at 500 knots

plain: Craft as big as a football field are said to be moving through the world's oceans at 500 knots, a speed far beyond any known submarine. The comedian and podcast host Joe Rogan repeats this on the show, crediting Marco Rubio, a senior US politician, who says it in a documentary film called The Age of Disclosure. The magician and YouTuber Chris Ramsay tells it differently. He credits Lue Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who ran a small office that studied unexplained aerial reports, with mentioning a giant underwater thing moving at 500 knots. Ramsay links it to an anonymous poster on 4chan, an online message board, known as the "4chan whistleblower", who he says described the same thing. Ramsay gives no size for the object. If true, it would mean huge unknown vehicles move under the sea faster than anything humans have built.
